title: Numbers to 20: Symbols, Names and Comparing
seo_title: Grade 1 Numbers to 20 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 1: Number symbols and number names
standard_text: Know number names and number symbols 1 to 100 (write number names 0 to 10); describe, compare and order numbers to 20.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 1 maths worksheets: number symbols and names, comparing and ordering numbers to 20. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Each number has a symbol (13) and a name (thirteen).
  • The bigger number is further along the number line.
  • To order numbers, start with the smallest.
  • Thirteen is 13; thirty is 30.

Examples

Example

Which is more: 14 or 11?

14 is further along

Answer: 14

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Reversed digits12 is not 21.
More or lessMore is the bigger number.
Teen or tyThirteen is 13; thirty is 30.
